negative_controls.failure_mode: A duplicate durable usage event could be counted twice.
negative_controls.plausible_wrong_implementation: A replay inserts another event or silently accepts a changed payload.

negative_controls.expected: Same payload returns created=false; changed payload is rejected.
negative_controls.observed: Replay is deduplicated and divergent payload raises usage_event_idempotency_conflict.

negative_controls.expected: Distinct productCode/versionCode persist without semantic relabeling.
negative_controls.observed: Persistence mapping kept productCode and versionCode distinct from planCode.
